q: A personal addition the room then adopts: T3-060 for the adding, T3-041 when the room takes it up as its own extension.
w: 'I want to add a bit to your Tom Searle memorial. Specifically, a cursor.' and 'I'm more than happy to help with this' add a member's own piece to the room's memorial (T3-060, reader B). The proposer brings 'a bit of support from r/placestart' and wants to 'run it by you guys'; the room answers 'we're cool' as long as trolls leave the mouse alone. Reader A read the cursor as the room extending its work (T3-041). T3-060's decide_when_both gives T3-041 when the room takes the addition up, and does not say whether approval on a condition is taking it up. Asking the host (T3-035) and the grant (T3-012) are one concept each, tied with no placement, so neither is added. My B1's T3-004 and T3-066 hold no argument on the look and no vote.

Members and other groups add their own pieces to the shared flag: a demiboy flag, a trans heart offered 'to help you fight against the void', the flag 'shooting out of Birdo's mouth', an ace heart fought over by three factions and remade by 'an army of 1', a Shoop da Whoop, a trans avocado, a Watch The Throne cover, RHPS and a genderfluid flag (T3-060, reader B and my B1), and lead by count. The room's own TRANS and TRANS PRIDE lettering, a second flag, 'Operation: flaghearts', a trans heart inside the void and new locations for the pan flag extend its work (T3-041, both readers). 'Donate blood', asked for three times, and 'Black Lives Matter', overwritten by a koala, with 'stop removing my black pixels' and 'where should we attempt again', are messages meant for viewers (T3-129, reader B). Turning 'the Trump suit into the trans flag' and a new flag over a Trump drawing convert others' art (T3-068, my B1), and 'Are memes allowed?' and 'Any room for a bisexual heart' ask the host (T3-035), two concepts each; rule 0's limit of three placements is reached.

'we must make it bigger' and making 'the black border of the AR logo bigger so someone else with more authority can make the text itself bigger' enlarge the room's own logo (T3-041, reader B and my B1). A Canadian member orders 'Keep your shitty pre-teen autism minecraft ripoff game off our flag', and the room answers 'you have a bigger flag somewhere. also i thought all canadians were nice????', a neighbour's demand for the room's space refused (T3-123, my B1). The two tie at two concepts, and T3-041 leads with two placements. Reader A read the enlargement as pushing into Canada's space (T3-061); no concept says the logo grows over the flag, and T3-041's discriminator against T3-061 sends growth onto the room's own work to T3-041.

q: Does the room grow into empty space or onto its own work (T3-041), or into a neighbour's space (T3-061)?
w: 'I propose colonizing the space on our right. That Kangaroo below us is expanding too fast for my comfort', 'Keep expanding to the left, I say. Edit: Rightwards' and 'lets take over the pony on the left to extend it!' take space in a race with neighbours (T3-061, reader B and my B1); 'keep expanding west' is T3-061's own example. Reader A placed the first two as growth into open space (T3-041) and only the pony as T3-061. The words do not say whether the space on the right is empty or held, and T3-041's discriminator against T3-061 turns on that.

'Tiny Tadis Plan', 'Tiny TARDIS Plan', 'Tiny TARDIS Projection' and 'Official plan!' post the plans for placers (T3-070, reader A and my B1), and lead by count. 'Perhaps we can get another tiny TARDIS going somewhere on the map', 'The plan for the second Tiny TARDIS' and 'New plan for TT3, compatible with /r/IST's shield' make further TARDISes (T3-041, reader B and my B1). 'The Tiny TARDIS' alone does not say whether it is a plan or the finished mark.

Both readers and my B1 placed T3-041 and T3-082, and the readers differ on which leads. 'it could be bigger tbh', 'I'm going to work on it and make it bigger', 'same' and establishing 'Sko Buffs' next to the logo enlarge it and add lettering beside it (T3-041), and lead by count. 'don't we already have one?' and 'oh.' find the room's logo already placed (T3-082).

'We've already got one complete with ASDS and falcon' and 'I completely missed /r/SpaceX part, and I came here instantly haha. I'm gonna remove the thread then.' find the room's mark already placed (T3-082, reader A); 'there already is one' is T3-082's own example. 'Help us create a SpaceX logo underneath at /r/Place' calls for another logo (T3-041, reader B), one concept with a placement. 'New logo on r/place' alone does not say whether it is another logo or the standing one. My B1's T3-015 needs a gathering thread, and the poster removes a duplicate with no pointer to one; my B1's T3-033 needs the room's first mark.

Leaving the flag 'sin escudo' because 'Esa bola verde en el medio como que esta rara', 'una botella de presidente o mamajuana', 'O platanos' and the defence of the 'escudito' as 'una aproximación en 8 bits' put national emblems in or beside the homeland flag (T3-113, reader A and my B1), by the homeland-flag reading met in this packet, and lead by count. 'PRD between the PR flag and the RD flag to show unity between our people' and 'make it DR & PR unity square' make one mark of the Dominican and Puerto Rican flags (T3-056, my B1). 'Añadamos una bandera cubana debajo de la nuestra' adds a further piece (T3-041, both readers), one concept with two placements. The PRD template and 'the Antilles on top of their crest' are one concept each. My B1's T3-004 holds no argument on the look apart from the shield, which is an emblem.

Writing 'South Africa' under the flag 'like Brazil and Argentina have done', 'Let's put our name below our flag!' and 'Table Mountain or Mandela Silhouette' add national words and pictures beside the homeland flag (T3-113, reader A and my B1), and lead by count; T3-041's discriminator against T3-113 sends a national emblem added to the flag to T3-113, against reader B's T3-041. The Zupta painting, 'Should we not draw Nkandla comrades?' and the call for 'Zuma Must Fall' on r/place bring national politics to the work (T3-130, my B1). 'Leave the SqSp colours in though', 'It's not going to fit. We need to do this' and the design being tried settle the label's look (T3-004, named by no placement). Asking r/sqsp, r/argentina and r/brasil for a banner (T3-035), 'replace HUEBR with RSA' (T3-068) and 'we can't do it on our own' (T3-136) are one concept each.

A sign that says '/r/partyparrot' under the parrot, 'Count me in!', 'Let's put r/partyparrot under the parrot on /r/place!' and 'I even started /R/PartyParrot underneath' write the sub's name (T3-169, reader B and my B1), by the boundary on the sub's name, and lead by count. 'establish a colony on the other side of the canvas' makes another piece (T3-041, reader A and my B1). 'PERFECT PARROT ACHIEVED. PARTY ON FRIENDS.' celebrates the finished parrot (T3-009, named by no placement), by the reading met in this packet that finished work celebrated is T3-009 at any time.

Both readers placed T3-042. 'our top priority is our own mural', the hope that some 'save our pixels for our own art only', 'i don't want to fight that is not our fight', 'abandoned keeble to protect sg ... but sg comes first' and 'The priority will always be BM and Sakura Gakuin' limit help to 'art around us' to keep the room's own work (T3-042). My B1 placed T3-069, which needs one of the room's pieces dropped for another; Kebble is not said to be the room's piece, and T3-069's must_not_show names upkeep with no piece dropped (T3-042).

'Now we get to defend it', 'Lets not be greedy', 'Greed could be our undoing, I like your plan. Switch to defensive', defending 'our territory, as well as RWBY, BikiniBottomTwitter, and the Trans Ribbon' and 'don't start digging into other's spaces, we've got our own established' set growth aside to keep what the room holds (T3-042, all three placements), and lead by count. 'a d20 in the space to the left of our CRITICALROLE logo', 'I honestly dont think we need to move a single thing' and 'New /r/place goal: The Hex logo' propose further pieces (T3-041, reader A). 'I say we capitalise' and 'just take over that small bit of blue and pink line' (T3-061), and a neighbour's 'respectfully asks you to back off' and concern that the d20 'will overlap our worm' (T3-139), are two concepts each, tied with no placement, so neither is added.

Both readers placed T3-042. 'Shouldn't we work on our own logo before we troll other teams?', 'can't spare the resources. Winged Wheel or bust!', 'Complete as much of it as we can', 'We cannot change location now!', 'Fight for our space' and 'Don't do it! The karma will come back to us.. people will start messing with ours' put upkeep of the Winged Wheel before side fights (T3-042), and lead by count. 'The Detroit Red Wings NEED YOU to help defeat the Seattle Mariners!!' and 'Should we have a go at destroying some Kanye shit or naw?' call for attacks on rivals' work (T3-006, my B1), which T3-006's must_show names. Waiting 'until the dirty limies go to sleep' to overwrite the UK bot's flag and finish the wheel's bottom is one concept. My B1's T3-069 needs a piece dropped, and the Stanley Cup script and the wheel both go on; my B1's T3-076 needs an attack under way, and none is.

'We need to preserve FLY EAGLES FLY ... Nothing else is important right now', 'force might encourage a war, and we have a lot to defend against as it is', 'I'm more focused on keeping ours together', 'stick to FLY EAGLES FLY' and abandoning the green fill set growth aside to keep the words (T3-042, all three placements), and lead by count. 'Fuck kyl are allies. Don't fuck with them.' and shortening 'the first Fly to give Calvin and Hobbs room' spare others' work by the room's own choice (T3-024, reader A). An r/rocketbeans member's 'don't ruin others work' and 'I am still salty about people disregarding others work' argue whether covering is fair (T3-046, my B1). These two tie at two concepts and one placement each. Changing black to gray 'to avoid attraction from the black void', twice, is a design change for protection (T3-055) with no placement, and the limit of three is reached. Honouring r/RBTV's request to stop the exclamation points (my B1's T3-039) is one concept.

'Goed op slot zetten', 'Op dit moment kunnen we beter projecten afronden dan nieuwe oorlogen starten', an attack that would bring 'een totale shitstorm', 'verdedigen van wat we al hebben is voor de nacht de hoogste prioriteit!' and maintaining the rest of the artwork put upkeep before growth (T3-042, all three placements). 'De leegte nadert onze westgrens!', the Dutch mini-flag 'onder aanval', the small EU flag 'zwaar onder vuur' and the r/Europe flag that survived repeated attacks fight attacks on the work (T3-005, reader A and my B1). The two tie at five concepts, and T3-042 leads with three placements. 'steunt onze italiaanse vrienden!' sends help to another room's work (T3-011, my B1). Tidying the western side is one concept.

'Better to focus on defending the core Day [9] TV logo and forget about "Be a better gamer"' drops the motto, a piece beside the logo, for the core (T3-069, reader B and my B1). 'Should we abandon the TV? Just allow the Day [9] to survive?' cuts the logo itself to a smaller version, which the reading met in this packet on a design cut down to the hands gives T3-004 (named by no placement). Reader A placed T3-042, which needs growth set aside; nothing here grows.

'On second thought I think we should focus on expanding the Pitt logo', '42-39 is enough of a victory for me', 'So we've lost our H2P, but we still need to maintain our current spot', 'I've stopped working on the H2P', 'it was agreed to stop and focus on our own thing' and 'Make it about Pitt' drop the room's other pieces for the Pitt logo (T3-069, reader B and my B1), which T3-042's decide_when_both gives T3-069. 'I suppose we've expanded enough for today, have we?' sets growth aside (T3-042, reader A), one concept with a placement. 'We don't really have the people to make a bigger one' (T3-004 by the cut-down reading) and 'We wont get as much resistance there' (T3-020) are one concept each, tied with no placement, so neither is added.

'Tirem-me o Eder dali', 'Isto ficava muito melhor sem o Eder', the answer 'E PORTUGAL CARALHO também não é a mesma coisa? Porque não te queixas disso? fds deixa estar.' and the 'Proposta para remover o vernáculo no Place' argue which figures and words the picture keeps (T3-004, my B1), and lead by count. Opposing SLB because 'uma guerra de clubes que vai desperdicar a energia que seria utilizada para acabar a pic' and 'o pessoal está mais interessado em terminar a parte laranja primeiro' refuse new pieces to finish the picture (T3-042, reader B). Reader A placed T3-069, which needs one of the room's pieces dropped for another; SLB and the IST logo were proposals, not pieces, and Eder's removal is argued on the look. The IST logo beside the flag (T3-041), a new home for r/IST (T3-012) and space won 'à boa maneira portuguesa' (T3-061) are one concept each.

'We did what we could with the space we had. It may not look like much, but that corner was a high visibility spot that was prime for griefing.' and the bottom-left corner as 'a popular are to look at and grief' explain a logo kept to what could be held (T3-042, reader A and my B1), and lead by count. 'By working together we showed that we are confident that our school is awesome. We didn't need to be salty.' reflects on working together (T3-157, reader B and my B1). 'We could have made it bigger but *most* of us decided to be respectful and work with the surrounding groups, including UF.' sizes the work to spare neighbours (T3-024, named by no placement), which T3-024's must_show names. The comparison with Ohio State, Tennessee and Texas A&M is one concept.

q: Is another picture remarked on (T3-052), or the room's own mark found already placed (T3-082)?
w: Members point one another to furry art on the canvas: 'Found at ~100, 900 on /r/place', four times, with an update, 'Now it says "yiff me daddy /r/furry"', and who made it, '/r/furry_irl did' and '/r/zootopia did it :)' (T3-082, reader A). T3-082's must_show names the room's subject drawn and asking who made it; its discriminator against T3-052 asks for the room's own mark, and reader B read the same finds as neighbouring pictures (T3-052). Directing a questioner to r/place and 'Is this like r/thebutton?' ask or answer what the event is (T3-016, reader A and my B1). 'Where is our sub located?', the snoo at 930, 630 and the r/0w0 and NightInTheWoods pointers are one concept each.

'so I got to 533 881 and it's fucking dat boi. cool' remarks on another picture found at the target (T3-052, reader A and my B1). 'Found Hodor's name on r/place' finds the room's subject already drawn (T3-082, reader B and my B1). Each has one concept and two placements; no rule breaks the tie, and T3-052 is listed first as in my B1 grouping.

q: A single member making a small piece alone and saying so: 'I wrote a small X, protect it', 'I added a little something for my bias', 'I decided to make a tribute'.
w: Both readers placed T3-060 for 'I added a little something for my bias'. T3-092's must_show quotes that sentence as its own example, which is how my B1 placed it. T3-092's discriminator against T3-060 asks whether the piece is added to a shared mark (T3-060) or made alone apart from one (T3-092), and 'added' names a shared mark. The readers' placement is taken; the example and the discriminator in T3-092 disagree.

'Focus on the pixel art, worry about the text later!', 'Focus on the Dashie first, then text/background', erasing 'PONIES!' to keep Rainbow spot-free, 'just erase the word ponies entirely' and 'just try to defend Rainbow Dash' over a new Fluttershy, with the answer that defending 'ponies' is more meaningful than folding, argue which of the room's pieces to drop (T3-069, all three placements), and lead by count. 'a little Pinkie Pie down with OSU', a spot for Sunset and 'a small Pinkie in the osu! logo' add pieces (T3-041, my B1). r/BerryTube's 'we need your help please!', the Berry Punch cutie mark at X:376 Y:592 'we would love to have your support' and 'help keep Berry safe as well' are another room's requests received (T3-084, named by no placement), by the reading carried from packet 2; reader A read them as help sent (T3-011), and T3-011's discriminator against T3-084 sends help asked for to T3-084. T3-041 and T3-084 tie at three, and T3-041 has a placement. 'Might as well throw my pixels in' (T3-011, reader A and my B1) and 'I don't think we should spread ourselves thin' (T3-042) are one concept each, and the limit of three is reached.

'Let's focus on this one' of two spots, 'I think we should decide on one logo to work on', 'We should focus on repairing the PCMASTERRACE sign first', 'Maybe the AMD one too', 'We should focus on our /r/place logo', spending pixels 'on keeping the AMD logo red instead' and 'we should rather finish our Masterrace icon!' over the FPS counter choose among the room's pieces (T3-069, all three placements), and lead by count. 'Just focus on defending our masterrace logo would ya?', against 'Just focus on *expanding* our FPS counter', and 'Just fight for our right to keep our hardware + games pure' put holding before growing (T3-042, reader A and my B1). Reader B's T3-091 needs placers held to one design of one piece; 'decide on one logo' narrows the pieces, which T3-069's discriminator against T3-091 sends to T3-069. A bigger logo and the FPS counter expanded (T3-041), G2A on the banner and 'an S instead of a Z' (T3-004), and the request to 'reduce your FPS' refused (T3-123) are two concepts each, tied with no placement, so none is added. Refusing to link 'the PC Master Race with racial supremacy or any kind of fascist ideologies' is one concept; my B1's T3-076 has no attack stopped.

q: Is a mark found that the room did not know of (T3-082), or the room's own work announced (T3-026)?
w: 'Where at? I spent forever trying to find it today' asks for a mark the member knew of, and the maker answers 'it's towards the top left corner at (38, 347), underneath the babymetal thing and above the ukraine flag ... it's really tiny lol', pointing others to where the room's mark is (T3-026, named by no placement), which T3-026's must_show names. Both readers placed T3-082, whose discriminator against T3-026 asks for a mark the room did not know of; the asker knew of it and could not find it. My B1's T3-018 holds no detail decoded.
